rows.grounds: refers to animals as the subject to be declared
qualifies animals as wild or forest-born

items.question: Which two categories of animals are included in the forthcoming exposition?
premises: The speaker announces a declaration concerning animals.
Animals are also specified as village-dwelling.
items.inference: The forthcoming exposition will cover both wild forest animals and domesticated village animals.
uncertainties: The specific animals within each category are not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: And I shall declare the animals, both those dwelling in the forest and those dwelling in the village.
